comment: Per-resort corrections applied by pipeline/normalize_osm.py (ADR-036). See whistler-blackcomb.overrides.json for the format. One polygon, way/893138900 (Whitetail Resort, landuse=winter_sports with leisure=sports_centre): the east face of the ridge above Blairs Valley near Mercersburg, from the summit to the base lodge and the snow tubing park, on one ticket and one map (Epic); it holds every lift and run. No other ski area lies in the box or the Overpass window. Every named run and lift checked on 2026-11-12 against Whitetail's Winter 2025-2026 trail map (20251219_WT_winter-trail_map_001.pdf, the James Niehues painting skiwhitetail.com/the-mountain/about-the-mountain/trail-map.aspx links): the site serves curl an error page, so the PDF (one 864 x 648 pt page, the painting with its trail and lift labels part of the image; its text layer holds only the key and the base-area labels) was fetched with WebFetch and rendered at two and four times its size, read tile by tile. Its key: Easier (green circle), More Difficult (blue square), Most Difficult (one black diamond), Extremely Difficult (two) and Freestyle Terrain (an orange oval), OSM's easy, intermediate, advanced and expert; its lifts are the Whitetail Express Quad, Expert's Choice Quad, EZ Rider Quad, Lift Off Quad, U-Me Double, First Class Magic Carpet, The Launching Pad, First Tracks and the tubing park's Magic Carpet, the nine lifts the resort's mountain-info page counts. The resort's lift and trail status loads by script, so the printed map is the source and wins. OSM draws most runs twice, as a line and as an outline (area=yes, as at Camelback); overrides name each way. All 21 of the map's trail names are in OSM, 19 under the map's name and with its rating: Bold Decision (two diamonds), Drop In, Exhibition and Far Side (one), Angel Drop, Bob Small's Traverse, Drop Out, Fallmount, Fanciful, Homerun, Limelight, Ridge Runner, Snow Dancer and Stalker (blue), Almost Home, Northern Lights, Sidewinder, SnowPark and Velvet (green). Lower Angel Drop, the blue trail from Angel Drop's foot to the base lodge, is OSM's Jib Junction line and its outline named Halfpipe (both expert in OSM): name and rating from the map. Its halfpipe, a line and an outline OSM names Half Pipe (man_made=piste:halfpipe) beside it, is on no part of the 2025-26 map, which marks freestyle terrain only on 101, and is hidden. 101, the short blue lane with the map's freestyle oval between SnowPark and Stalker, is OSM's Park Place (a snow park, line and outline: renamed); OSM's second Park Place outline lies round the Stalker line below it and is renamed Stalker, with no park flag (blue on the map, no freestyle mark). The resort's terrain-parks page counts two parks and names none. Kept as OSM has it: the Whitetail Learning Center, a beginner outline at the lesson centre the map labels Whitetail Lesson Center, and the tubing park's carpet, unnamed in OSM (the map's Magic Carpet). The tubing lanes are left out by the type rule, as are seven short piste:type=yes ways. OSM gaps: the First Tracks carpet beside The Launching Pad.

overrides.reason: Park Place (OSM's line, a snow park): the short lane from below the EZ Rider Quad's top between SnowPark and the woods down to Stalker, which Whitetail's Winter 2025-2026 trail map (20251219_WT_winter-trail_map_001.pdf, the James Niehues painting skiwhitetail.com/the-mountain/about-the-mountain/trail-map.aspx links) labels 101, with a blue square and the freestyle oval. Name from the map; OSM's rating is the map's.

Park Place (OSM's outline round the line of that name, a snow park): the lane Whitetail's Winter 2025-2026 trail map (20251219_WT_winter-trail_map_001.pdf, the James Niehues painting skiwhitetail.com/the-mountain/about-the-mountain/trail-map.aspx links) labels 101, with a blue square and the freestyle oval. Name from the map; OSM's rating is the map's.

Park Place, OSM's second outline of that name (a snow park): it lies round OSM's Stalker line, below 101 down to the EZ Rider Quad's bottom, which Whitetail's Winter 2025-2026 trail map (20251219_WT_winter-trail_map_001.pdf, the James Niehues painting skiwhitetail.com/the-mountain/about-the-mountain/trail-map.aspx links) labels STALKER with a blue square and no freestyle mark. Name from the map, and no park flag (the outline would otherwise draw Stalker as a park); OSM's rating is the map's.

Jib Junction: the trail from Angel Drop's foot past Bob Small's Traverse to the base lodge, which Whitetail's Winter 2025-2026 trail map (20251219_WT_winter-trail_map_001.pdf, the James Niehues painting skiwhitetail.com/the-mountain/about-the-mountain/trail-map.aspx links) labels LOWER ANGEL DROP with blue squares and no freestyle mark; OSM names it Jib Junction and rates it expert. Name and rating from the map.

Halfpipe: the outline round OSM's Jib Junction line, from Angel Drop's foot to the base lodge, which Whitetail's Winter 2025-2026 trail map (20251219_WT_winter-trail_map_001.pdf, the James Niehues painting skiwhitetail.com/the-mountain/about-the-mountain/trail-map.aspx links) labels LOWER ANGEL DROP with blue squares and no freestyle mark; OSM rates it expert. Name and rating from the map.

Half Pipe (OSM's line, man_made=piste:halfpipe): a 141 m pipe beside Lower Angel Drop's lower half. Whitetail's Winter 2025-2026 trail map (20251219_WT_winter-trail_map_001.pdf, the James Niehues painting skiwhitetail.com/the-mountain/about-the-mountain/trail-map.aspx links) draws no halfpipe there or anywhere, and marks freestyle terrain only on 101; hidden as a feature the resort no longer shows.

Half Pipe (OSM's outline, man_made=piste:halfpipe): the pipe beside Lower Angel Drop's lower half.
